title: Noir Luxe Retreat
description:
Welcome to Noir Luxe Retreat, where modern style meets comfort & relaxation. This stylish retreat offers a warm, sophisticated atmosphere w/ cozy furnishings, elegant decor, & plenty of natural light. Kick back in the inviting living room, sip your morning coffee on the private balcony, or unwind after a day of exploring. Whether you're here for a getaway or simply need a place to recharge, Noir Luxe Retreat is your perfect home away from home!

The space
Enjoy a stylish and comfortable 2-bedroom, 2 bathroom apartment with everything you need for a relaxing stay. The private space includes a cozy living area, fully equipped kitchen, washer and dryer, and plenty room to unwind.

Step outside and enjoy a private balcony. The kitchen is stocked with convenient extras including a Keurig, air fryer, & slushie machine- perfect for making your stay a little more enjoyable!

Guests have access to the entire private apartment, making it a comfortable home base for couples, families, friends, or business travelers.

Guest access
Guests have full private access to the entire 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartment during their stay, including the living room, kitchen, bedrooms, washer and dryer, balcony, and patio.

All listed amenities are available for guests to enjoy during their stay.
